input.decision: Stage: results/invoice check (post-visit documents). The landlord approved the glazing quote at £180 total in event 010, and event 011 restated it as £150 + VAT. Those two figures agree (£150 + 20% VAT = £180), so there is no real discrepancy. Clearfirth Glazing's invoice NBL-013-INV-09 (event 023) describes supplying and fitting 1 pane of glass but shows no amount. The history does not show a visit date, an appointment confirmation or a completion report: the last contractor update (event 021, 2 September) said the glass had not arrived. Event 022 moved the case to post-visit with no evidence of a visit. Under PM-DOC-001 I cannot forward the invoice to the landlord or close the job until the amount and the completion are confirmed. I have emailed the contractor, with the invoice attached, asking for a revised invoice showing net, VAT and total against the approved £150 + VAT, and for the fitting date and anything seen at the window. I have also asked the tenant to confirm the fit and whether the misting, the water at the frame or any damp continues. The case is on hold, Waiting for Provider, until 12/09/2025. Once both answers are in hand and the invoice matches £180, I will send the landlord the completion email with the invoice attached and run the final checks. If the invoice comes in above £180, it goes back to the landlord for approval first. If the tenant reports continuing water or damp, the landlord will be asked whether to investigate it.
